info.name: Weld REST Connection Bridge Custom Reports API

items.docs: Create one or more custom reports (GAQL for Google Ads, ShopifyQL for Shopify) and attach them to the given ELT Syncs. Batchable: pass multiple items to create the same or different reports across many ELT Syncs in a single call. Each item is processed independently, so one failing item does not affect the others.
